curated_comment: Gureng Gureng (gure1255, ISO gnr, Pama-Nyungan, Queensland) is an ergative language with a human/non-human split: human NPs and all pronouns take the ERG suffix -bo, while non-human NPs appear in the unmarked nominative-absolutive (Brasch 1975, p.145, 147). GB409_19=0 because non-human (inanimate) NPs in A position do not take the ERG marker. GB409_22=1 because humanness is an additional conditioning factor for ergative marking. GB409_11 and GB409_13 are inferred as 1 based on Pama-Nyungan typology; direct evidence is unavailable due to poor OCR quality of the source scan. GB409_15, 17, 21 remain '?' due to insufficient evidence. GB409_23=0 and GB409_24=0 (genitive and comitative markers are distinct from ERG). Glottocode gure1255 is correct.
